solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Friendly note in a message

indicators.note: the note sits in the middle of the message, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a cable is a telegram, a message sent by wire
MI (or ME) is the third note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A friendly little note tucked inside a longer message.
explanation.definitionFit: Amicable relations are friendly ones; the two words are close synonyms.

clue.text: A girl to help people out

indicators.note: the people stand out around the help, so they form the outside of the word

parts.note: men is a common crossword stand-in for people
aid means help

explanation.surface: A young woman volunteering to help people out.
explanation.definitionFit: Maiden is an old word for a young unmarried woman, a girl.

clue.text: An act that violates an act

definitions.text: An act that violates an act

parts.words: An act that violates an act
parts.note: the first act is a deed; the second is an act of parliament, a law that the deed breaks

explanation.definitionFit: An offence is a deed that breaks a law passed as an act of parliament.

clue.text: An arm put round pretty girl in game

indicators.note: the girl is put round the other pieces, so they go inside her

parts.note: a belle is a beautiful girl
gives A
a gat is slang for a gun, a firearm

explanation.surface: An arm wrapped around a pretty girl during a game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Arm' looks like a limb but is a weapon: GAT is gangster slang for a pistol.
explanation.definitionFit: Bagatelle is a table game in which balls are struck towards pins and holes.

clue.text: Pen love-letters perhaps, and enclose

indicators.note: the letters of the words are to be treated as loose letters and rearranged

explanation.surface: Writing love letters and sealing them in envelopes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'letters perhaps' tells you to treat PEN LOVE as letters and shuffle them to get the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To envelop is to wrap up or surround completely, to enclose.

clue.text: Blue flower?

parts.note: a flower here is something that flows, a river, and the blue one is famous from a Strauss waltz

explanation.definitionFit: The Blue Danube is the Strauss waltz named after the river, and a river is a flower in the sense of something that flows.

clue.text: He is one immersed in studies

indicators.note: one piece is plunged inside the other

parts.note: dens are private rooms for study
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A man described as wholly absorbed in his studies.
explanation.definitionFit: Denis is a man's name, so the pronoun stands for a male person bearing it.

clue.text: X marks the spot in a political address

definitions.text: X marks the spot in a political address

parts.words: X marks the spot in a political address
parts.note: X is the Roman figure for ten, and it is also the famous door number of the British Prime Minister's residence in Downing Street

explanation.definitionFit: Number Ten Downing Street is the London home of the British Prime Minister, and X is ten in Roman figures.

clue.text: Once in a lifetime phenomenon?

parts.note: something that happens very rarely is said to happen once in this rare kind of moon

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom once in a blue moon means very rarely, matching a once-in-a-lifetime event.

clue.text: Demanding it needs a return telephone call

indicators.note: the word comes back on itself, so it is read backwards

parts.note: to give someone a ring is to telephone them

explanation.surface: A demanding person insisting on a call back.
explanation.definitionFit: A demanding task is a tiring one, wearing out whoever does it.

clue.text: It's poisonous, move us on out of the way

indicators.note: the letters are shifted out of their usual positions and rearranged

explanation.surface: A warning that something poisonous lies ahead, so step aside.
explanation.definitionFit: Venomous creatures inject poison, so the word is a synonym for poisonous.

clue.text: A supporter of the arts

parts.note: it reads like a patron, but means something that physically holds up works of art such as statues

explanation.definitionFit: A pedestal is the base on which a statue or vase stands, literally holding up art.

clue.text: Group in second year displaying risqué behaviour?

indicators.note: the group sits inside the other letters

parts.note: a team is a group working together

explanation.surface: A clique of second-year students behaving badly.
explanation.definitionFit: Steamy describes something erotic or racy, as in a steamy scene.

clue.text: North or South, it's the best place to start from

definitions.meaning: each is a geographic pole, so either describes a location of that kind

definitions.text: the best place to start from
definitions.meaning: in motor racing, the front spot on the starting grid

explanation.surface: Debating whether north or south is the best place to begin.
explanation.definitionFit: The front of a racing grid goes to the fastest qualifier, and the North and South poles are positions.

clue.text: Charge sheet?

parts.note: not a police record of offences, but a sheet listing what a seller charges

explanation.definitionFit: A list of the charges for goods is literally a sheet of charges.

clue.text: Such work gives you little standing

definitions.text: Such work gives you little standing

parts.words: Such work gives you little standing
parts.note: it sounds like work with low status, but means a desk job done sitting down

explanation.definitionFit: Sedentary work is done seated, so it involves little time on your feet.

clue.text: He succeeds where all others fail

definitions.text: He succeeds where all others fail

parts.words: He succeeds where all others fail
parts.note: succeeds here means inherits, and the others fail to inherit because there is only one beneficiary

explanation.definitionFit: The only person to inherit an estate succeeds to it while nobody else does.

clue.text: A copper ring?

parts.note: copper is slang for a police officer, and the ring is a line of them around a scene

explanation.definitionFit: Police officers forming a barrier around an area make a ring of coppers.

clue.text: Looking out for a situation for the hands?

definitions.meaning: being alert as a lookout or sentry
the hands of a clock are positioned upon a timepiece

explanation.surface: Sailors keeping lookout while the crew get to work.
explanation.definitionFit: A sentry is on duty keeping lookout, and clock hands sit on the face of a timepiece.

clue.text: One who takes orders to break the circle

indicators.note: breaking the circle scatters its letters into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone obedient breaking ranks from a circle.
explanation.definitionFit: A cleric has taken holy orders, the ordination into the clergy.

clue.text: A break in the depression

definitions.meaning: a pause or holiday, as when parliament stops sitting
a hollow or alcove set back into a wall

explanation.surface: Taking time off during an economic slump.
explanation.definitionFit: A recess is both a pause from work and an indentation or alcove.

clue.text: Dishonest, and wary about publicity

indicators.note: the wary word goes around the publicity

parts.note: shy can mean wary or cautious, as in shy of strangers
an ad is an advertisement, a piece of publicity

explanation.surface: A crook who prefers to stay out of the limelight.
explanation.definitionFit: Shady dealings are dubious or crooked, so the word means dishonest.

clue.text: Unexpected but fruitful result of a sharp blow

definitions.text: Unexpected but fruitful result of a sharp blow

parts.words: Unexpected but fruitful result of a sharp blow
parts.note: a blow here is a gust, and what it knocks from the trees is fruit, as well as any unlooked-for gain

explanation.definitionFit: Fruit blown down by a gale is the literal sense, and a sudden piece of good fortune the figurative one.

clue.text: It is in fact a point of view

definitions.text: It is in fact a point of view

parts.words: It is in fact a point of view
parts.note: the letters of fact surround the letter E to give an aspect, a way of looking at something

explanation.walkthrough: Read 'It is in fact' literally: the word is fact with one letter (E) inserted. The rest defines it as an aspect of a matter.
explanation.definitionFit: A facet is one side or aspect of a question, a particular angle from which it is seen.

clue.text: The saint not usually regarded as being in doubt

indicators.note: the letters are not seen in their usual arrangement, so they are reordered

explanation.surface: A saint whose holiness is called into question.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone hesitant is uncertain or in two minds.

clue.text: Bill is on the line expressing agreement

parts.note: AC is short for account, a bill
a cord is a length of string or line

explanation.surface: A bill sitting on the phone line, voicing agreement.
explanation.definitionFit: An accord is a formal agreement or harmony between parties.

clue.text: Fine for a non-drinker found in quarry

indicators.note: the non-drinker is discovered inside the quarry

parts.note: quarry as the hunted animal means prey
TT is teetotal, abstaining from alcohol

explanation.surface: A teetotaller fined after being found in a stone quarry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'quarry' suggests a stone pit, but here it is the hunted animal.
explanation.definitionFit: Pretty can mean fine or nice, as in a pretty sight.

clue.text: Pile of food the farmer may plunge his fork into

definitions.text: Pile of food the farmer may plunge his fork into

parts.words: Pile of food the farmer may plunge his fork into
parts.note: it sounds like a heaped dinner plate, but the food is fodder for animals and the fork a pitchfork

explanation.definitionFit: A stack of dried grass for livestock is forked by farmers with a pitchfork.
